title: Categorical Naive Bayes Model of Morphological Slot Dynamics in the Voynich Manuscript: A Rigorous Attribute-Tagging Architecture and Corpus Audit
summary: The Voynich Manuscript (MS 408) has long resisted decipherment under standard natural language translation paradigms and classical substitution ciphers. In this paper, we present a mathematically rigorous computational framework reframing MS 408 not as an unmapped spoken natural language, but as a synthetic, low-entropy attribute-tagging system operating under strict phonotactic constraints.
